call.rating_hurdle: A new fundamental Buy requires financing evidence and at least 30% base-case upside: at the current base cash path, a price no higher than about $37.39, or a defensible base value above $55.34 at the $42.57 reference price. Neither alone is sufficient while debt availability and mature-fleet replacement capex remain unverified.
call.strongest_objection: Management says project loans, prepayments and operating cash can cover the significant majority of capital needs; new contracts and paid-off GPUs may make this model too conservative. Conversely even 6.8 x EBITDA assumes 60% normalized unlevered cash conversion after maintenance replacement and tax, which is not established by disclosures.
call.summary: Hold / no new fundamental Buy at the $42.57 reference close. The illustrative base value is $48.60 (+14.2%), below a 30% analyst risk-margin hurdle. Its cash path still needs $26.08 billion of gross new borrowing plus $7.90 billion of gross equity, neither assured. This is a conditional scenario, not a firm fair-value target.

original_model.method: Adjusted EBITDA=R×margin; EBITDA=adjusted EBITDA−SBC (other EBITDA adjustments assumed0). D&A=R×D&A ratio; SBC=R×SBC ratio. Pretax=adjusted EBITDA−D&A−SBC−interest; tax=25%×max(pretax,0); net income=pretax−tax (simplified GAAP-style forecast, not issuer adjusted net income). FCF=adjusted EBITDA−cash interest−cash tax−cash capex+customer receipts−prepaid revenue recognition (20%×R), with other working-capital changes assumed0. Equity proceeds=new ATM shares×assumed issue price×98%. New debt=max(0,3000−opening cash−FCF+scheduled principal−equity proceeds). Ending debt=opening debt−scheduled principal+new debt. Interest=rate×average opening/ending debt, solved iteratively; cash=opening cash+FCF+draw+equity proceeds−principal. Shares include assumed vesting/issuance, no automatic conversion.
